why_this_proof_exists: the staging gate resolves rows.jsonl only, and its new ENTITY grain matches on entity_key. :Formula and :FormulaFamily carry no entity_key -- their identities are formula_id and family_id -- so neither the PASSAGE grain nor the ENTITY grain can resolve this domain's sidecar subjects. Rather than let them go unchecked behind a passing per-mantra rows.jsonl, every sidecar key is resolved against the live store here. This is the same defect class commit c39a34f fixed, one node label further out.
grain_declaration: rows.jsonl is passage-grained and that is the correct grain for it: it reports per-mantra formula and parallel state. It is NOT a proxy for a different subject. The pair-grained and formula-grained outputs are in relations.jsonl, formula_nesting.jsonl, uses_formula_match_level.jsonl and shares_formula_with.jsonl, all checksummed in manifest.files, and all resolved above. A pair cannot be a rows.jsonl row at all, because row.no_duplicate_key_source forbids two rows sharing a canonical_key.
